# Gummy's Home Cooking

> Black-owned soul food restaurant on Midlothian Turnpike in Southside Richmond, Virginia. Every entree is named for someone in the family and comes with 2 sides. Dine-in, takeout and call-ahead orders. There is a bar.

## Contact & location
- Name: Gummy's Home Cooking
- Address: 7503 Midlothian Tpke, Richmond, VA 23225 (Midlothian Turnpike, Southside Richmond)
- Wayfinding: Between the Latino Market & Goodyear
- Phone: (804) 447-5907 (call ahead to place an order)
- Website: https://gummys-home-cooking-website.netlify.app/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Gummy%27s+Home+Cooking%2C+7503+Midlothian+Tpke%2C+Richmond%2C+VA+23225

## Hours (Eastern Time)
- Friday: 12 PM - 6 PM
- Saturday: 12 PM - 6 PM
- Sunday: 12 PM - 5 PM
- Monday - Thursday: Closed
- Hours occasionally change (for example, an early close on a Sunday). Day-of updates are posted on Instagram.

## Cuisine & service
- Soul food, Southern
- Dine-in, takeout, call-ahead orders
- Bar on site
- Black-owned (self-described)

## Menu highlights (prices from the printed in-house menu; subject to change)
### Entrees (each comes with 2 sides; every entree carries the name of someone in the family)
- Papa's Fried Fish (3 pieces): $20.00
- Elma's Fried Shrimp (10): $22.00
- Papa's Fried Fish (3) & Elma's Fried Shrimp (4): $25.00
- Susie's Fried Chicken Wings (4): $18.00
- Johnnie's Smothered Pork Chops (2): $21.00
- Charlie's Baked Turkey Wings (2): $24.00
- Bertha's Baked Chicken: ask for price
- Wilbur's Pig Feet: ask for price
- Buddy's Beef Ribs (Sunday only): ask for price

### Sides
- Shellie's Mac & Cheese $6.50; Perlene Potato Salad $5.00; Sweet Potato Fries $4.00; Swamp Cabbage $5.00; May-Belle Yams $5.00; Girlie Greens $5.00; French Fries $3.50

### Sandwiches (with fries)
- Pork Chop Sandwich $13.99; Shrimp Po Boy $15.99; Fish Po Boy $14.99

### Salads
- Shrimp Taco Salad $15.99; Fish Taco Salad $13.99

### Appetizers
- Fried Mushrooms $5.00; Steak Egg Roll $6.00; Fried Okra $5.00; Onion Rings $5.00

### Kids meals (with fries & drink)
- Grilled Cheese $5.99; Shrimp (5) $7.99; Chicken Tenders (2) $6.99

### Drinks
- Pepsi Products $2.99; Sweet Tea $2.99; Bottle Water $2.00

### Desserts
- Assorted Dessert $5.00

### Rotating specials & favorites (check Instagram)
- Shrimp po' boy, cheese steak egg rolls, crab dip & chips, shrimp taco salad, jumbo shrimp dinner, peach cobbler, homemade rolls, assorted cakes, beef short ribs

## Price guide
- Entrees with 2 sides: $18 - $25
- Sandwiches with fries: $13.99 - $15.99
- Sides: $3.50 - $6.50
- Kids meals: $5.99 - $7.99

## Reviews

## FAQ
- What are the hours? Friday and Saturday 12 PM - 6 PM, Sunday 12 PM - 5 PM; closed Monday - Thursday.
- Can I call ahead? Yes, call (804) 447-5907 to place your order ahead.
- Dine-in or takeout? Both, and there is a bar.
- Do entrees come with sides? Yes, every entree comes with 2 sides.
- When are Buddy's Beef Ribs available? Sundays only.
- Where is it? 7503 Midlothian Tpke, Richmond, VA 23225, between the Latino Market & Goodyear.
